name: codehike-lms
description: Author complete LMS2 lesson content: CodeHike MDX sections, element records for all 11 types, runnable static/Vite playgrounds, and whole backup files that validate clean.

interface.shortDescription: Author complete LMS2 lesson content: MDX, elements, playgrounds, backups.
interface.longDescription: Create student-facing LMS2 content end to end. codehike-content writes lesson sections and inline fields as CodeHike MDX with annotated code, Scrollycoding walkthroughs, Spotlight comparisons, code tabs, Mermaid diagrams, alerts, accordions, and tooltips. lms-elements authors complete records for all 11 element types (markdown, multiple-choice, free-response, code-playground, image, youtube, file-submission, link, feedback, data-table, image-gen). lms-playground builds runnable static or Vite playground file sets for the in-browser WebContainers sandbox. lms-backup assembles whole course/unit/lesson/section backup files with deterministic ids and ranks that validate clean against the platform's import validator.
defaultPrompt: Write an LMS2 lesson section on Python loops with annotated code and a practice question.
Create a Scrollycoding walkthrough of JavaScript fetch.
Build a static p5.js playground exercise for students learning loops.
Create a multiple-choice element record about Python loops, with hint and explanation.
Make an LMS2 backup file: a new unit with two lessons, each containing a markdown section and a code playground.
